raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.12.0"
  build_number: 3
  # see github.com/conda-forge/conda-forge.github.io/issues/1059 for naming discussion
  proc_type: ${{ "cuda" ~ cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" }}
  # we don't want to leave random substitution left-overs; use naming of CUDA 12 for CPU variant
  cuda_pseudo_so: ${{ (cuda_compiler_version|default("12") | split('.'))[0] ~ "0" }}

recipe:
  name: tinygrad
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 5bddedec6fcf4e963a957c270532599ccab798f41dfb335f00abe9c4b291cf9c
    patches:
      # search CONDA_PREFIX first, esp. for llvmdev/clangdev/CUDA
      - patches/0001-look-for-libraries-in-PREFIX-first.patch
      # see more clearly what's happening in mnist test
      - patches/0002-update-accuracy-for-every-step-in-beautiful_mnist.py.patch
      # use CONDA_BUILD_SYSROOT instead of whatever's lying around in image
      - patches/0003-use-our-standard-macos-sdk.patch
      # ensure we find vendored applegpu
      - patches/0004-make-apple-disassembler-runnable-when-installed.patch
      - if: osx and x86_64
        then:
          # disable metal on osx
          - patches/0005-default-to-CPU-as-device-on-osx-64-remove-metal.patch
      - if: osx and arm64
        then:
          # cannot disassemble metal when using vanilla clang; see
          # https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad/issues/14005
          - patches/0006-skip-metal-disassembly-for-vanilla-clang.patch
      # revert https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad/pull/14086 (until we have ggml)
      - patches/0007-Revert-don-t-skip-gguf-test-if-ggml-is-not-installed.patch
      - patches/0008-skip-test-for-models-that-are-not-available-anymore.patch
      # nvcc complains if clang is too new, even with v20, which upstream uses
      - patches/0009-allow-newer-clang-with-nvcc.patch
      - patches/0010-avoid-redundant-definitions-of-INFINITY-NAN.patch
      - if: osx and arm64
        then:
          - patches/0011-force-metal-version.patch
  - if: osx and arm64
    then:
      - target_directory: tinygrad/extra/disassemblers/applegpu
        git: https://github.com/dougallj/applegpu
        rev: "797862eea0cee1f1eba74be3d0d02be4b3d2bd0d"

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ proc_type }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - match(python, "<3.11")

outputs:
  - package:
      name: tinygrad
    build:
      script:
        # do this unconditionally to not leave around random substitution left-overs
        - 'sed -i "s/@CUDA_VERSION@/${{ cuda_pseudo_so }}/" tinygrad/runtime/autogen/__init__.py'
        - 'sed -i "s/@CUDA_VERSION@/${{ cuda_pseudo_so }}/" tinygrad/runtime/autogen/nvjitlink.py'
        - 'sed -i "s/@CUDA_VERSION@/${{ cuda_pseudo_so }}/" tinygrad/runtime/autogen/nvrtc.py'
        - python -m pip install . -vv
        - if: osx and arm64
          then:
            - mkdir -p $SP_DIR/tinygrad/extra/disassemblers/applegpu
            - cp -R ./tinygrad/extra/disassemblers/applegpu/* $SP_DIR/tinygrad/extra/disassemblers/applegpu
            - cd $SP_DIR/tinygrad/extra/disassemblers/applegpu/compiler_explorer_tools
            - make
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ host_platform }}
        # this is just here so smithy creates separate jobs for the CUDA variants
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
            - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
            - ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
        - if: osx and arm64
          then:
            - make
            # for bare clang/clang++ symlinks, see
            # https://github.com/dougallj/applegpu/blob/main/compiler_explorer_tools/Makefile
            - clang
            - clangxx
        - if: unix
          then: sed
          else: m2-sed
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
      run:
        - python
        - capstone
        - llvmdev
        - clangxx_${{ host_platform }}
        # tinygrad wants headers from `include/clang-c`; also ensure `bin/clang` symlink is present
        - clangdev
        # avoid solver choosing ancient clang versions
        - clang >18
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - __cuda
            - cuda-nvcc_${{ host_platform }}
            - cuda-nvrtc-dev
            - libnvjitlink-dev
            - if: x86_64
              then:
                - cuda-opencl-dev
            - if: linux
              then:
                - triton
      run_constraints:
        - if: linux
          then:
            # avoid wrong compiler activation that interferes with clang_<target>
            - gcc_linux-64 <0.0a0
            - gxx_linux-64 <0.0a0
            - gcc_linux-aarch64 <0.0a0
            - gxx_linux-aarch64 <0.0a0
        - if: win
          then:
            # avoid pulling in old MSVC activation
            - vs2019_win-64 <0.0a0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - tinygrad
            - tinygrad.runtime.autogen.libclang
            - tinygrad.runtime.autogen.llvm
          pip_check: true
      - script:
          # not covered by bare import test, because these are all members with try/except fallbacks
          - python -c "from tinygrad.runtime.autogen.libclang import clang_getFile"
          - python -c "from tinygrad.runtime.autogen.llvm import LLVMParseBitcode"
          - if: linux
            then:
              - python -c "from tinygrad.runtime.autogen.libc import syscall"
          - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
            then:
              - python -c "from tinygrad.runtime.autogen.nvrtc import nvrtcGetPTXSize"
              - python -c "from tinygrad.runtime.autogen.nvjitlink import nvJitLinkAddFile"
          - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and x86_64
            then:
              - python -c "from tinygrad.runtime.autogen.opencl import clGetDeviceInfo"
      # integration-test in addition to test suite below
      - files:
          source:
            - examples/beautiful_mnist.py
        script:
          # reduce number of steps; we just need to show that it's functional
          # however, accuracy should at least trend in the right direction
          # we remove $PYTHON because it makes Tensor.device autoselection choke
          - if: unix
            then:
              - export STEPS=25
              - export TARGET_EVAL_ACC_PCT=90
              - unset PYTHON
            else:
              - set "STEPS=25"
              - set "TARGET_EVAL_ACC_PCT=90"
              - set "PYTHON="
          - if: match(cuda_compiler_version, "!=13.0")
            then:
              - python ./examples/beautiful_mnist.py
          # run again with high DEBUG value; exercises different paths, e.g. needs capstone
          - if: unix
            then:
              - export STEPS=1
              - export DEBUG=10
              - unset TARGET_EVAL_ACC_PCT
            else:
              - set "STEPS=1"
              - set "DEBUG=10"
              - set "TARGET_EVAL_ACC_PCT="
          - if: not aarch64 and match(cuda_compiler_version, "!=13.0")
            then:
              # suppress enormously noisy output; re-enable if things actually fail
              - python ./examples/beautiful_mnist.py > /dev/null

  - package:
      name: tinygrad-tests
    build:
      skip:
        # redundant but: https://github.com/prefix-dev/rattler-build/issues/2110
        - match(python, "<3.11")
        # onnxruntime not available in this platform/python combo
        - osx and x86_64 and match(python, ">=3.14")
      # splitting off what conda packages under etc/conda/test-files when using test.files.source
      script:
        - if: unix
          # silly: https://github.com/prefix-dev/rattler-build/pull/1367
          then: true
          else:
            - echo "nothing"

    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('tinygrad', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - requirements:
          run:
            # minimal
            - pytest
            - pytest-xdist
            - hypothesis
            - ml_dtypes
            - numpy
            - pytorch
            - z3-solver
            # optional
            - blobfile
            - boto3
            - bottle
            # https://github.com/conda-forge/staged-recipes/issues/29179
            # - ggml-python
            - if: unix
              then:
                # not available on windows yet
                - jax
            - librosa
            - networkx
            - nibabel
            - onnx2torch
            - onnx
            - onnxruntime
            - openai
            - pandas
            - py-opencv
            - pybind11
            - pycocotools
            - pillow
            # Makes test/unit/test_disk_tensor.py::TestSafetensors::test_load_supported_types fail
            - safetensors <0.8.0dev0
            - sentencepiece
            - tabulate
            - tiktoken
            - tqdm
            - transformers
        files:
          source:
            - examples/
            - extra/
            - test/
        script:
          interpreter: python
          content:
            - 'import pytest'
            - 'import sys'
            - 'import os'
            # $PYTHON makes Tensor device autoselection choke
            - 'os.environ.pop("PYTHON", None)'
            - 'os.environ.setdefault("ONEDNN_VERBOSE", "all")'
            - 'tests_to_skip = "_not_a_real_test"'
            - if: linux
              then:
                # fails `assert Device.DEFAULT in failed_platforms`
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or (TestLinearizerFailures and test_failure_27)"'
                # Causes `Fatal Python error: Bus error` + segfault
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or testCopySHMtoDefault"'
                # RuntimeError: Attempting to relocate against an undefined symbol 'fmaxf'
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_backward_sum_acc_dtype"'
                # cannot load onnx model from some temporary location
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or (TestQuantizeOnnxCPU and test_quant_128)"'
                # No such file or directory: '/tmp/tmpqhndyk1l.so'
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_bitfield_interop or test_packed_struct_interop"'
                # mismatch in expected number of relocations
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_load_clang_jit_strtab"'
                # flaky, server seems to hang or run into a race condition of sorts
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_getotherprocess or test_putotherprocess"'
            - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version != "None"
              then:
                # GC clean-up error
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_assign_refcount"'
                # RuntimeError: Attribute list does not match Module context!
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_bf16_disk_write_read"'
                # expects zero memory use for `.schedule()`
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_schedule_mem_used"'
                # slightly higher memory use than anticipated
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_unet_resblock"'
                # somehow fails to stat (or create?!) a temporary file
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_save_all_dtypes"'
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or (TestDiskTensorMovement and test_slice)"'
            - if: linux and aarch64
              then:
                # expects array([0]), gets array([255])
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_float_cast_to_unsigned_underflow"'
            - if: linux and aarch64 and match(python, ">=3.13")
              then:
                # These fail with: could not create a primitive descriptor for the ... primitive.
                # Run workload with environment variable ONEDNN_VERBOSE=all to get additional diagnostic information.
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_gemm_fp16 or test_conv2d_fused_half or test_conv2d_half"'
            - if: osx or (linux and cuda_compiler_version != "None")
              then:
                # beam-related stuff seems to hang on metal, OOM/crash with CUDA
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or TestBEAM or test_beam"'
            - if: osx
              then:
                # another apparent hang
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_getotherprocess"'
                # forking too early
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_putotherprocess"'
                # running into weakly-referenced object no longer exists
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or TestGC or test_gc"'
            - if: osx and arm64
              then:
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or (TestOpsUint8 and test_cast)"'
            - if: osx and x86_64
              then:
                # signed int32 overflow
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_float_midcast_int32"'
                # tinygrad.codegen.kernel.KernelOptError: must have tensor cores or TC=2
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_unmerged_ifs"'
                # RuntimeError: The MPS backend is supported on MacOS 14.0+
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_torch_interop"'
                # element mismatch in array
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_conv2d_fused"'
                # flaky hypothesis test
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_float_cast_to_unsigned"'
                # less operations on CPU than expected on metal, apparently
                - 'tests_to_skip += " or test_jit_split_simple"'

            # test suite in emulation on aarch is super slow, skip it there
            - if: unix and build_platform == host_platform
              then:
                - 'sys.exit(pytest.main(["-v", "test/", "-k", f"not ({tests_to_skip})", "--durations=50", "--maxfail=20"]))'
